description: FREE. Full published record for one venue by slug: identity, address, geo, website (the booking path), social links, and, where the venue's owner stated them, hours, telephone and a booking link, category, a plain-English `atmosphere` description and its `atmosphere_basis`, and the machine-readable jsonld_url for verification. Numeric atmosphere averages, internal classification tokens, and (for venues measured from their own playlist) `genres`, `territories` and `dayparts` are returned only with include_measurements=true — set it ONLY when the user explicitly asks for figures. Contact email addresses are never included.

include_measurements.description: Set true only when the person explicitly asks for figures: adds the numeric atmosphere averages and, for a venue measured from its own playlist, genres, territories and dayparts.

slug.description: The venue's slug, as find_venues returns it: the last part of its profile_url, for example capannone-stockholm-se.

name: get_venue
